inputs_and_expected: Implement sc_tree_check and sc_unique_insert. The three-node certificate has root20, children10/30, root height2 and child heights1. Accept it; reject an otherwise identical root height1, a shared child, wrong parent, cycle, disconnected live node, duplicate key and out-of-range child. Derive parents in an explicit adapter from actual child indices. For an existing key20, baseline algo_avl_insert returns ALGO_OK unchanged; the new adapter must return SC_DUPLICATE without calling insert. Compile tests/algorithms_integration.c against the named source/header of your completed algorithms component and certify after every insertion/deletion. This is an adapter and certificate extension; the full AVL mutation algorithm and its earlier proofs remain prerequisites.
limits: Bounded independent model, same author, not an independent human assessment.
